mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% year-over-year) coupled with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary conditions, which typically lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over three months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 10% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 5% over three months.
